text: Quickstart sets up a React app, indexes sample data, and builds a search interface with React InstantSearch
quote: Set up a React app, index sample data in Algolia, and build a search interface with React InstantSearch.

text: Quickstart React app searches a sample product catalog, filters by product type, and paginates results
quote: This quickstart builds a React app that searches a sample product catalog, filters by product type, and paginates results.

text: Official CLI works with Algolia APIs from the terminal for interactive commands, scripts, and CI workflows
quote: The Algolia CLI lets you work with Algolia's APIs from your terminal. It's great for interactive commands, scripts, and continuous integration workflows.

text: CLI authenticates through a browser sign-in and can create a new Algolia account during sign-in
quote: You’ll need an Algolia account. If you don’t have one yet, create one from the CLI while you sign in.

text: CLI can list applications and interactively select the current one
quote:
algolia application list     # list your applications
algolia application select   # pick the current one interactively

text: CLI runs on macOS, Linux, and Windows on both AMD64 and ARM64
quote: The CLI runs on macOS, Linux, and Windows, on both AMD64 and ARM64 platforms.

text: Agent skill manages indices, settings, rules, and synonyms through the Algolia CLI
quote: `algolia-cli` Manage indices, settings, rules, and synonyms via the Algolia CLI

text: Search API lets you search, configure, and manage indices and records
quote: The Algolia Search API lets you search, configure, and manage your indices and records

text: API requests are authenticated with application ID and API key headers
quote:
Add these headers to authenticate requests:

*   `x-algolia-application-id`. Your Algolia application ID.
*   `x-algolia-api-key`.

text: Configure searchable attributes and apply custom ranking to tailor relevance
quote: Choose a good set of searchable attributes. Apply custom ranking to adapt Algolia to your needs.

text: Ranking combines textual factors such as typos and stop words with non-textual criteria such as geolocation
quote: To find results, Algolia uses text-based comparisons like typos and stop words, and non-textual factors such as criteria and geolocation.

text: Rules override relevance and reposition products, including temporary promotions, without changing settings or records
quote: If one of your products isn’t appearing where you want it to in your search results, you can reposition it. Rules let you make precise and (if desired) temporary modifications to your search results.

text: Merchandising Studio provides visual tools to curate, pin, and boost search results
quote: Merchandising Studio - Visual tools for curating, pinning, and boosting search results

text: Typo tolerance works out of the box and can be customized
quote: Algolia provides typo tolerance out-of-the-box, along with some important ways to customize just how tolerant a search experience should be.

text: InstantSearch.js is an open-source vanilla JS UI library for building frontend search interfaces
quote: InstantSearch.js is an open source UI library for vanilla JS that lets you build a search interface in your frontend app.

text: InstantSearch offers predefined CSS-styleable widgets, customizable render output (DOM or Native), and fully custom widgets
quote: InstantSearch offers three levels of increasing control over your UI: Start with a predefined widget... customize a predefined widget... create a custom widget.

text: refinementList widget lets users refine searches by attributes such as brand
quote: add the [`refinementList`](/doc/api-reference/widgets/refinement-list/js)` widget and ask it to show a list of brands, so your users can refine their search using those brands.

text: Browse & Navigation supports category pages, filtering, and faceted navigation
quote: Browse & Navigation - Category pages, filtering, and faceted navigation

text: Search analytics report popular searches, no-result searches, and click-through rates
quote: Search analytics offer insights into what your users search and which results they select through metrics such as popular searches, no results, and click-through rates.

text: Analytics include click tracking and conversion metrics
quote: Analytics - Search analytics, click tracking, A/B testing, and conversion metrics

text: Analytics comparison mode compares metrics between date ranges
quote: To compare the performance of your metrics between different periods, click **Comparison mode** and select the date ranges you want to compare.

text: Analytics can include data from other indices, including replicas
quote: If you want to include analytics from other indices (including replicas), select Include other indices.

text: Analytics data can be exported and downloaded as CSV or XLSX
quote: To export any of the metrics from the Algolia dashboard, click Download. You can export and download your analytics data as CSV or XLSX files.

text: A/B testing runs two alternative search experiences live so you can compare them
quote: Consider A/B testing to create two alternative search experiences, put them both live and see

text: Prebuilt integrations ingest data from Shopify, Adobe Commerce, BigCommerce, commercetools, Salesforce B2C Commerce, and Zendesk
quote: If your data is in one of these platforms, use an integration: Shopify, Adobe Commerce, BigCommerce, commercetools, Salesforce B2C Commerce, or Zendesk.

text: Shopify and BigCommerce integrations provide a search UI and send click and conversion events
quote: Shopify and BigCommerce also provide a search UI and can send click and conversion events.

text: Crawler extracts content from web pages and turns it into records
quote: If your content is only web pages, and you don't have an API or database export, use the Crawler. The Crawler extracts content from your pages and turns it into records.

text: Crawler agent skill crawls pages or whole sites into a RAG-optimized index
quote: `algolia-crawler` Crawl web pages or whole sites into a RAG-optimized index with the Algolia Crawler

text: Algolia manages ingestion schedules, retries, and transformations, configured in the dashboard without deploying code
quote: Algolia keeps the schedule, the retries, and the transformations. Configure them in the Algolia dashboard without deploying code.

text: Algolia searches a copy of your data stored in indices rather than querying your database
quote: Algolia doesn’t query your database. It searches a copy of your data, stored as in an . After you’ve structured your data into records, choose how to send them to Algolia.

text: Agent Studio connects your chosen LLM to Algolia search and tools and grounds responses in live index data
quote: Agent Studio connects your chosen LLM to Algolia search and tools. It manages the end-to-end workflow and grounds responses in live data from your Algolia indices.

text: Agent Studio builds shopping assistants that answer product questions and recommend items
quote: Shopping assistants that answer product questions and recommend items.

text: Agent Studio builds conversational search for natural-language queries
quote: Conversational search for natural language queries.

text: Agent Studio can build content summarizers
quote:
Agent Studio lets you create:

*   **Shopping assistants** that answer product questions and recommend items.
*   **Content summarizers**...
*   **Conversational search** for natural language queries.

text: Agent Studio caches LLM completions by default to reduce provider token costs
quote: Completions are cached by default to minimize your LLM provider token costs.

text: NeuralSearch provides hybrid keyword and vector semantic search
quote: AI Search (NeuralSearch) - Hybrid keyword + vector semantic search

text: Official API clients for JavaScript, Python, PHP, Ruby, Go, Java, Swift, Kotlin, and .NET
quote: Official clients for JavaScript, Python, PHP, Ruby, Go, Java, Swift, Kotlin, .NET

text: Official API clients are covered by Algolia's Service Level Agreement
quote: The official API clients are covered by Algolia’s Service Level Agreement

text: Migration skill updates API client code to the latest major version across 10 languages
quote: `algolia-migration` Migrate API client code to the latest major version (JS, Python, Go, PHP, Java, C#, Ruby, Kotlin, Scala, Swift)

text: Official MCP server exposes search, analytics, and recommendations to agents
quote: `algolia-mcp` Search, analytics, and recommendations via the Algolia MCP server

text: Agent skills let AI agents manage Algolia search, analytics, recommendations, and index configuration
quote: Agent skills for managing Algolia search, analytics, recommendations, and index configuration.

text: Build with AI guide prepares AI agents to work with Algolia
quote: Are you building with AI agents? To prepare your agent to work with Algolia, see Build with AI.

text: algolia.com website content is indexed in Algolia and can be queried directly
quote: The algolia.com website content is indexed in Algolia and can be queried directly.

text: Personalization builds user-level affinity profiles for personalized ranking
quote: Personalization - User-level affinity profiles for personalized ranking

text: Recommend provides ML-based recommendations: frequently bought together, related items, and trending
quote: Recommend - ML-based product recommendations (frequently bought together, related items, trending)

text: 99.999% uptime SLA
quote: SLA (99.999% uptime SLA)

text: Retry strategy with fallback server URLs provides high availability for API requests
quote: To guarantee high availability, implement a retry strategy for all API requests using the URLs of your servers as fallbacks

text: Server URLs distribute requests with load balancing for high availability
quote: Both URLs provide high availability by distributing requests with load balancing.

text: Distributed Search Network routes requests to the servers closest to users
quote: If your subscription includes a Distributed Search Network, this ensures that requests are sent to servers closest to users.
